gd.f: (endocrinology) Initialism of gain of deiodinases: the sum activity of peripheral deiodinases.

gda.f: (biochemistry) Abbreviation of glycyldodecylamide, a derivative of the amino acid glycine.

gdal.f: (software) Initialism of Geospatial Data Abstraction Library (a computer software library for reading and writing raster and vector geospatial data formats.)

gdi.f: (computing, Microsoft, Microsoft Windows) Initialism of Graphics Device Interface.
(euphemistic, slang, rare) Abbreviation of goddamn it.

gdl.f: (law, England and Wales) Initialism of Graduate Diploma in Law.

gdn.f: (chiefly UK, in street addresses) Abbreviation of garden.

gdna.f: (genetics) Initialism of genomic DNA (DNA in chromosomes).

gds.f: (travel, aviation) Initialism of Global Distribution System.
